photo_observations.method: Manual side-photo points, uncalibrated perspective; choose a 9-degree correction from current approximately 3-degree swingarm slope.
Compare lens aspect ratio and side housing depth using 00/01/04; add long black fork support sleeves visible in those photos.
photo_observations.uncertainty: Contour points ±4 pixels; hidden bracket and housing depth ±15–20 mm.

photo_observations.method: Add rear crankcase shoulder below carburettor, air-cleaner lower continuation and their mounts. Preserve cooling openings in front of engine.
photo_observations.uncertainty: Visible envelopes estimated ±10–20 mm; no hidden mechanical internals claimed.

criteria: Chaincase seam slopes down toward rear axle in LH side view
Front and rear chaincase attachments remain together; rear wheel axle fixed
Deep headlamp side shell and long black support sleeves visible
Engine/admission gap reduced by identifiable component volumes
No arbitrary cover over cooling opening

cowl_reprofile.method: Continuous deformation of outer and inner shell together, with inverse-transpose Jacobian correction of original corner normals. No overlay panel; original topology retained.
